annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) - Analysis of the final compromise text with a view to agreement
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) - Analysis of the final compromise text with a view to agreement
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Council of the European Union (Presidency / General Secretariat)
annotation.summary_en: Council Presidency note (26 Jan 2024) analysing the final compromise text of the EU AI Act after the December 2023 trilogue, with the full annexed text. It covers risk-based tiering, prohibitions, high-risk requirements, GPAI model rules, governance via the AI Office, penalties and entry-into-application timelines, including product-safety linkages for robots and machinery.
key_provisions_or_claims: Prohibits practices such as social scoring, untargeted facial scraping, workplace/education emotion recognition, with narrow law-enforcement exceptions for real-time biometric ID
High-risk AI systems face risk management, data governance, oversight and conformity assessment; product-embedded AI follows Annex II harmonisation legislation (machinery, medical devices)
New GPAI model rules; systemic-risk threshold of 10^25 FLOPs with AI Office oversight
Fines up to EUR 35m or 7% turnover for prohibited practices
Phased application: 6 months for prohibitions, 24 months general, 36 months for Annex II products
